text:
Sam: Ok team tiny crisis — my 'lucky sock' (yes, I keep one in my desk drawer) has vanished. Last seen under the blue binder. :crying_cat_face:
Maria: you keep a sock at work? iconic. :laughing:
Zach: not the sock again. last week someone used my stapler as a spoon and I still have nightmares. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
Ella: I swear, that was me but for emergency cereal. not the sock tho. :grimacing:
Alex: dev-bot where are lost personal items stored?
dev-bot: Heads up — Lost & Found now lives on Kitchen Shelf 2. Report items to #help if you want them logged.
Jordan: Plot twist: sock joined the wild plant community behind the monitors. :leaves:
Sam: quick poll — whoever finds it gets a $5 coffee, whoever took it owes a latte. options: (A) Jordan, (B) Alex, (C) Ghost of Friday Lunch, (D) Sam planted it himself
Maria: I humbly nominate C. who would steal a sock specifically? :thinking_face:
Zach: I voted D because Sam is a performance artist.
Alex: low-effort detective move: check under standing-desk mats, lots of small mysteries hide there.
Sam: BREAKING: located! it was under the old anti-fatigue mat by my desk. crisis averted. coffee for the first person who guessed "mat". :coffee:
Ella: winner winner sock and coffee dinner. :tada:
Maria: note to self: do not trust standing-desk mats, they are sock black holes. :black_circle:
Sam: thanks all. also, I will stop keeping footwear office supplies in drawers. maybe.
